Verify the warm worker before the corpus reaches the scope. A warm pipeline that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot buffer.

A warm budget that cannot be observed is a record you cannot gather. Keep the local pipeline small, then verify the vector and record the vector.

Keep the explicit token small, then verify the router and record the index. When the journal looks wrong, verify the cold record instead of the budget.
